episode_records.instruction: Simultaneously grab the bread with golden crust and the doughy and soft bread using the dual arm, then drop them in the wooden breadbasket.
Lift the square-shaped bread and the golden bread loaf with soft inside with two arms, put in the beige breadbasket for holding bread.
Pick the smooth crusty small bread and the bread loaf with square shape, place them in the oval basket for bread.
Lift the smooth loaf with rounded edges and the bread loaf with square shape at once with the dual arm, then set them in the breadbasket with spiral lines.
Lift the bread with split top and the smooth crusty small bread at once with the dual arm, then set them in the textured beige breadbasket.
